method: Actual combatTick, 40 class/pet pairs; normal99/reborn120; uncommon/mythic pets; field/boss/pack. Identical fixed gear, paid skills and default rotations across no-card / old unrestricted / new restricted policies. 10 character-bound slots active with or without equipment for both policies, isolating position limits. All current farmable cards available in unlimited quantities for comparison, not an estimate of acquisition time. Two-pass coordinate greedy selection of a declared damage/cast/tempo/crit/penetration and lightly weighted effective-HP/mana proxy, fixed before combat. NOT exhaustive best builds. Same selected cards for all seeds/scenarios/rarities for a job/role/rebirth. Legacy unobtainable cards excluded. Marginal utility is a selection proxy, not a measured DPS increase. Combat contribution includes effective healing, mitigation and consumed shields; no direct-damage parity assumed for defense/support pets. No combat coefficient changes.
